text: Its output, the plan , is a tree of nodes .

text: The leaves read data: a Seq Scan (sequential scan) reads every page of a table in order; an Index Scan walks an index and fetches the matching rows; a Bitmap Heap Scan first collects matching row addresses from an index and then reads their pages in physical order; an Index Only Scan answers from the index without touching the table.
